subject: Exception request: Hosted API pricing concession for Polaris Health (>20%)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Polaris carve — need exec exception for hosted usage pricing

Team — quick summary and ask. Polaris Health (Alice Jennings / Samir Patel) are ready to commit to a 12-month pilot starting Sept 1. They expect an immediate ramp to ~120M tokens/month after onboarding (month 2) and have a clinical integration timeline that makes them strategic for our health vertical roadmap.

Current list pricing would make this a marginal economic decision for them; they've asked for a 28% off hosted API usage rate to match a competing incumbent and to keep the implementation timeline. Deal specifics attached (usage projection + draft SOW).

Why I'm escalating: our pricing guardrails cap standard sales-authorized discounts at 20%. Polaris is asking materially beyond that (28%). If we approve a deeper concession, recommended structure to protect unit economics:
- 22% up-front discount guaranteed for first 6 months, stepping to 15% thereafter if they hit committed monthly usage thresholds; OR
- 28% for year 1 with a minimum ARR commit and 6-month payback clause (preferred by customer).

Financials in the attached projection show burn vs. revenue at both structures. Also flags: clinical integration requires private VPC option later, which could convert to a Dedicated deal.

Request: Can we get exec sign-off to approve up to 28% for year 1 with the recommended minimums OR a counter at 22% with structured commit? Need decision by EOD tomorrow to avoid losing the implementation slot.

Attachments: Polaris_Month1_usage_projection.xlsx, SOW_Polaris_v2.pdf

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Polaris carve — need exec exception for hosted usage pricing

Thanks Ben — I reviewed the projection quickly. A few clarifying points before I escalate to the exec committee:
1) Confirm whether the customer will sign a 12-month minimum ARR or if they want to do a 3-month pilot with an option to expand. The level of commitment materially changes acceptable concession.
2) What are the exact onboarding / professional services asks? If they're pushing for VPC later, costs could rise.
3) Is Polaris already under an RFP with the competitor? If so, do we have any competitive differentiators (latency SLO, streaming, or observability) we can lean on instead of pure price?

Assuming they want 28% for a 12-month committed deal, I'm open to recommending the 22% structured approach (Ben's first option) to protect our margins, but we should outline minimum token thresholds and an overage mechanism. Mina — can you run the two structures in our unit-econ model and give loss/risk assessment (3-yr NPV impact) within the day? Laura — if we need an exception beyond 22% under strict conditions, flag the acceptability of the strategic win.

I'll hold escalation until I see Mina's numbers.

-Markus
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 15:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Polaris carve — need exec exception for hosted usage pricing

Markus / team — ran the unit-econ scenarios. Summary (high level):
- Option A (22% first 6 months, 15% thereafter with committed thresholds): NPV neutral after 18 months assuming they hit 85% of forecasted tokens by month 4; breach clause with step-up pricing recovers ~60% of near-term delta.
- Option B (28% year 1 with minimum ARR & 6-month payback clause): downside exposure is greater — NPV negative in case of delayed ramp. However, with a contractual minimum ARR (50% of forecasted year-1 tokens billed regardless of usage) and a clause that allows automatic rate normalization if usage underperforms after month 3, risk becomes manageable.

Recommendation: approve a structured concession capped at 25% as a middle ground with a required minimum ARR and an accelerated reconciliation clause at month 3. That gives sales leverage vs competitor, reduces our exposure vs a straight 28% concession, and keeps momentum.

I've attached the sensitivity table in Polaris_Month1_usage_projection.xlsx. If approved at 25% we should also require:
- 30-day trial window where Redwood can meter production traffic and validate expected latency and token mix;
- Signed SOW + payment terms (net 30) before discount applies;
- Clause to renegotiate if Polaris moves to Dedicated (on-prem/VPC) within 6 months.

If you want, I can draft the redline language for the order form today.

-Mina
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alice Jennings <alice.jennings@polarishealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@polarishealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Polaris carve — need exec exception for hosted usage pricing

Markus / Ben — after reviewing Mina's analysis and the strategic upside (health vertical reference customer + potential Dedicated conversion), I approve an exception up to 25% for year 1 under the following binding conditions:
1) Minimum ARR equal to 50% of our year-1 forecast (written into order form).
2) 3-month ramp review with automatic rate normalization if usage < 60% of forecast at month 3.
3) Signed SOW and payment terms executed prior to discount start; net 30.
4) Executive review if Polaris requests a VPC/Dedicated conversion within the first 6 months (financial terms to be revisited).

Ben — communicate this to Polaris and send a redlined order form with the clauses above. Ask them to sign and return the SOW + order form by EOD Friday to lock their onboarding slot. I'll notify finance and deal desk to prepare for the concession.

Copying Alice and Samir so they have visibility into the terms.

Thanks — Laura
VP, North America Sales
Redwood Inference
